info.title: CodeContext API
info.description: Local code context API for LLMs - provides dependency graph and code relationships

get.description: Returns the OpenAPI 3.0 specification for the CodeContext API
Returns comprehensive system health and debugging information.

get.summary: Get complete context for an identifier
get.description: Returns comprehensive context information for a code construct. Searches by name or file path. Without 'type' parameter, searches across all entity types and returns best match or multiple matches. With 'type' parameter, searches only within specified type. Returns array of matches to handle ambiguity.

parameters.name: identifier
parameters.description: Canonical returned identifier, name, or repository-relative/absolute file path

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by type (Class, Method, Interface, Property, etc.)

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: How many relationship levels to traverse (0-10)

parameters.name: includeTests
parameters.description: Whether to include test-related information

parameters.name: includeContent
parameters.description: Whether to include file content snippets

parameters.name: exact
parameters.description: Exact matching; omit for exact-first matching with substring fallback

parameters.name: includeRelated
parameters.description: Whether to include loosely related same-file/namespace symbols

parameters.name: includeMetrics
parameters.description: Whether to include heuristic code metrics

parameters.name: maxMatches
parameters.description: Maximum ambiguous candidate summaries to return (1-50)

parameters.name: maxRelationships
parameters.description: Maximum entries returned per relationship list (1-100)

parameters.name: maxCallSites
parameters.description: Maximum locations returned per aggregated relationship (0-100)

parameters.name: maxTestFiles
parameters.description: Maximum test files returned; zero is count-only (0-100)

parameters.name: maxTestMethods
parameters.description: Maximum test methods returned per file; zero is count-only (0-100)

parameters.name: expandAmbiguous
parameters.description: Expand bounded ambiguous matches instead of returning summaries

parameters.name: containingType
parameters.description: Filter members by containing type

parameters.name: namespace
parameters.description: Filter by exact namespace or module

parameters.name: signature
parameters.description: Filter by exact signature

parameters.name: sourceFile
parameters.description: Filter by repository-relative or absolute source file

parameters.name: view
parameters.description: Response shape: compact (default) or full

post.description: Returns context for multiple code constructs as a round-trip optimization. It reduces HTTP requests, not response-token size.

Triggers a re-parse of the specified file or the entire codebase. If path is provided, only that file is refreshed synchronously. If path is omitted, a full background rescan starts (202) and the response carries an operationId observable via /api/status; returns 409 if a scan is already in progress.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Path to the file to refresh. If omitted, performs full scan.

post.description: Returns an on-demand, parser-specific syntax tree for an indexed file. Use the normalized context endpoints for cross-language relationships; use this endpoint for exact syntax, tokens, nesting, and language-specific constructs.

get.description: Returns 200 as soon as the HTTP host is accepting requests. Use /api/status to determine whether indexing has completed.

post.description: Requests a graceful shutdown of this CodeContext instance. Requires the target instance's instanceId as a query parameter. The instance unregisters itself from the instance registry on exit.
